name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
description: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

name: Dark Balter the Terrible
description:
"Possessed Dark Soul" + "Frontier Wiseman"
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

name: Lesser Fiend
description: Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card.

name: Possessed Dark Soul
description: You can Tribute this face-up card; take control of all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters your opponent currently controls.

name: Skull Knight #2
description: If you Tribute Summon a Fiend-Type monster by Tributing this monster, Special Summon 1 "Skull Knight #2" from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Ryu-Kishin Clown
description: When this card is Summoned (including Flip Summon and Special Summon), select 1 face-up monster on the field and change its battle position.

name: Twin-Headed Wolf
description: While you control another Fiend monster, negate the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

name: Opticlops
description: A one-eyed giant that serves the "Dark Ruler Ha Des", it skewers its enemies with its sharp horn, shattering them to pieces.

name: Bark of Dark Ruler
description: If a Fiend-Type monster you control battles, during the Damage Step: Pay LP (in multiples of 100 points), then target the opponent's battling monster; that opponent's monster loses that much ATK and DEF, until the end of this turn.

name: Fatal Abacus
description: Each time 1 monster is sent from the field to the Graveyard, inflict 500 points of damage per card to the respective card owner's Life Points.

name: Life Absorbing Machine
description: During your Standby Phase, gain Life Points equal to half of the total Life Points you paid during your last turn.

name: The Puppet Magic of Dark Ruler
description: Select 1 Fiend-Type monster from your Graveyard. Remove from play monsters on your side of the field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the selected Fiend-Type monster. Then Special Summon the selected monster from your Graveyard.

name: Soul Demolition
description: You can only activate this card's effect when you have a Fiend-Type monster on your side of the field. Pay 500 Life Points to use this effect. Both players select 1 Monster Card from their opponent's Graveyard. Remove the selected cards from play.

name: Freed the Matchless General
description: Negate any Spell effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Throwstone Unit
description: Tribute 1 Warrior-Type monster on your side of the field to destroy 1 face-up monster on the field whose DEF is equal to or less than the ATK of this card.

name: Marauding Captain
description: Your opponent cannot target Warrior monsters for attacks, except this one. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.

name: Ryu Senshi
description:
"Warrior Dai Grepher" + "Spirit Ryu"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. When a Normal Trap Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can pay 1000 LP; negate that effect. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Negate the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy it.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
description: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

name: Mysterious Guard
description: FLIP: Target 1 face-up monster on the field, and if you control a face-up Warrior-Type monster, you can target 1 additional face-up monster on the field; return the first target to the top of the Deck, then return the additional target (if any) to the hand if you still control a face-up Warrior-Type monster.

name: Frontier Wiseman
description: Negate any Spell effects that target a Warrior-Type monster you control, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Exiled Force
description: You can Tribute this card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: The Hunter with 7 Weapons
description: When this card is Normal Summoned, declare 1 Type of monster. When battling that Type of monster, increase the ATK of this card by 1000 points during Damage Calculation.

name: Shadow Tamer
description: FLIP: Target 1 Fiend-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

name: Dragon Manipulator
description: FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of the End Phase.

name: The A. Forces
description: All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster you control.

name: The Warrior Returning Alive
description: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Ready for Intercepting
description: Target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: A Feint Plan
description: A player cannot attack face-down monsters during this turn.

name: Emergency Provisions
description: Send any number of other Spell/Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard; gain 1000 LP for each card sent to the Graveyard this way.

name: Tyrant Dragon
description: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the GY, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon monster.

name: Spear Dragon
description: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Spirit Ryu
description: During your Battle Step, if this card battles (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Dragon monster to the GY; this card gains 1000 ATK/DEF until the end of the Battle Phase.

name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
description: A huge dragon dwelling in a cave. It is horrible when it gets angry, although it is usually quiet. It is said to preserve certain treasures.

name: Fiend Skull Dragon
description:
"Cave Dragon" + "Lesser Fiend"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Material Monsters. Negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card.

name: Cave Dragon
description: Cannot be Normal Summoned while you control a monster. This card cannot declare an attack unless you control another Dragon-Type monster.

name: Troop Dragon
description: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Troop Dragon" from your Deck.

name: The Dragon's Bead
description: Discard 1 card from your hand. Negate the effect of a Trap Card that targets 1 face-up Dragon-Type monster and destroy the Trap Card.

name: A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon
description: Return 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster you control to the hand, and if you do, destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Stamping Destruction
description: If you control a Dragon monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

name: Dragon's Rage
description: Dragon-Type monsters you control inflict piercing Battle Damage when they attack a Defense Position monster.

name: Burst Breath
description: Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster; destroy all face-up monsters on the field whose DEF is less than or equal to the ATK the Tributed monster had on the field.

name: Luster Dragon #2
description: This dragon feeds on emerald. Enchanted by this monster even when attacked, few people live to tell of its beauty.

name: Robotic Knight
description: The Commander of Machine-Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.

name: Wolf Axwielder
description: Once it has started battle, this monster attacks fiercely and cannot stop.

name: The Illusory Gentleman
description: Wearing odd fashions, this gentleman is very fickle. He sometimes saves people and at other times commits crimes.

name: Patrician of Darkness
description: You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks.

name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
description: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

name: Airknight Parshath
description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
description: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

name: Susa Soldier
description: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent's Life Points is halved.

name: Heart of Clear Water
description: If the equipped monster's ATK is 1300 or higher, this card is destroyed. The monster equipped with this card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effect of a card that targets the monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

name: A Legendary Ocean
description:
(This card's name is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

name: Fusion Sword Murasame Blade
description: Equip only to a Warrior-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. While equipped to a monster, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

name: Creature Swap
description: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Second Coin Toss
description: When a coin toss is performed, you can choose to redo the coin toss. (If the toss involved multiple coin flips, redo all of them.) You can only use the effect of "Second Coin Toss" once per turn.

name: The Secret of the Bandit
description: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Each time the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points this turn, your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Magic Reflector
description: Target 1 face-up Spell Card you control; place 1 counter on it. If it would ever be destroyed, remove the counter instead.

name: Blast with Chain
description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Disappear
description: Remove from play 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard.

name: Bottomless Trap Hole
description: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

name: Bad Reaction to Simochi
description: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, any effect of increasing your opponent's Life Points is changed to inflict the same amount of points in damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Ominous Fortunetelling
description: During your Standby Phase, select 1 random card from your opponent's hand. Call the type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap). If you call it right, inflict 700 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. You can use this effect only once per turn.

name: Nutrient Z
description: During damage calculation, when you are about to take 2000 or more battle damage: Gain 4000 LP first.
